meta.aciklama:
Claude can paint your game art, pixel by pixel.

1. Grab the free pxl repo (it ships as a Claude skill)
2. Ask for a scene, like a witch's cottage
3. Claude writes one tiny file, you watch it paint live in your browser
4. Export PNGs, sprite sheets and animated GIFs

Heads up: it needs Node 22.18 or newer, and it's a young repo.

Send this to the friend who keeps saying they'll make a game.

Comment SPRITE and I'll send you the repo link.

#claudecode #pixelart #gamedev #indiegame

transkript.t: Claude can now paint every sprite for your game, pixel by pixel, that's because a free
github repo turns Claude into a pixel artist past 400 stars in two weeks.
So you ask for a witch's cottage and Claude writes one tiny file that paints it.
Then it hands you sprite sheets and even animated gifs ready for your game.
And you don't need to draw a single pixel yourself.
For the repo link, comment, write.
